:::{#sol-prereq-boolean}

The expression is `True`.
Here `x % 3` is 2,
so `not (x % 3 == 0)` is `True`.
Also `x == 2` is `True`,
so `x > 4 or x == 2` is `True`.
Then `True and True` is `True`.

The [Propositional Logic](propositional-logic.qmd) chapter
treats `and`, `or` and `not` as operations on truth values,
called [logical connectives](#def-logical-connective).

:::
